title: Memory Management
summary: This module provides various memory implementations for storing and managing conversation history in AI applications, ranging from simple buffers to more advanced summarization and entity-aware memories.

nodes.label: BaseMemory
nodes.title: BaseMemory Abstract Class
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all memory implementations, specifying methods for loading, saving, and clearing conversation context.

nodes.label: BaseChatMemory
nodes.title: BaseChatMemory Abstract Class
nodes.description: Extends BaseMemory for chat-specific memory, managing chat message history and handling input/output extraction for conversation turns.

nodes.label: ConversationBufferMemory
nodes.title: ConversationBufferMemory
nodes.description: Stores the entire conversation history as a buffer, either as a string or a list of messages, without any summarization or pruning.

nodes.label: ConversationStringBufferMemory
nodes.title: ConversationStringBufferMemory
nodes.description: A string-based conversation buffer memory, similar to ConversationBufferMemory but optimized for string inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: ConversationBufferWindowMemory
nodes.title: ConversationBufferWindowMemory
nodes.description: Maintains a sliding window of the 'k' most recent conversation turns, dropping older messages to manage context size.

nodes.label: ConversationSummaryMemory
nodes.title: ConversationSummaryMemory
nodes.description: Continuously summarizes the conversation history, updating the summary after each turn to provide a concise context to the model.

nodes.label: ConversationSummaryBufferMemory
nodes.title: ConversationSummaryBufferMemory
nodes.description: Combines a running summary with recent messages, pruning older messages and updating the summary to stay within a token limit.

nodes.label: ConversationEntityMemory
nodes.title: ConversationEntityMemory
nodes.description: Extracts and summarizes named entities from chat history, using an entity store to persist and retrieve entity information across conversations.

nodes.label: InMemoryEntityStore
nodes.title: In-Memory Entity Store
nodes.description: A simple, in-memory implementation for storing and retrieving entities, suitable for transient entity management.

nodes.label: RedisEntityStore
nodes.title: Redis-backed Entity Store
nodes.description: Persists entities using a Redis database, offering configurable time-to-live (TTL) for entity data.

nodes.label: UpstashRedisEntityStore
nodes.title: Upstash Redis-backed Entity Store
nodes.description: A Redis-backed entity store specifically for Upstash Redis, providing similar persistence and TTL features.

nodes.label: SQLiteEntityStore
nodes.title: SQLite-backed Entity Store
nodes.description: Stores entities in an SQLite database, ensuring persistence and safe query construction for entity management.

nodes.label: ConversationVectorStoreTokenBufferMemory
nodes.title: ConversationVectorStoreTokenBufferMemory
nodes.description: Combines token-buffered memory with a vector store for long-term context retrieval, timestamping interactions for better LLM understanding.

nodes.label: BaseChatMessageHistory
nodes.title: Base Chat Message History
nodes.description: An external component providing the base interface for storing and retrieving chat messages.

nodes.label: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: An external component representing the base interface for language models, used for summarization and entity extraction.

nodes.label: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: An external component defining the base interface for prompt templates, used to format inputs for language models.

nodes.label: VectorStoreRetriever
nodes.title: Vector Store Retriever
nodes.description: An external component for retrieving relevant documents or information from a vector store.

groups.label: Base Abstractions
groups.title: Base Memory Abstractions
groups.description: Core abstract classes defining the fundamental interfaces and behaviors for all memory implementations.

groups.label: Buffer Memories
groups.title: Conversation Buffer Memories
groups.description: Implementations that store conversation history directly, with variations for full history, string-based, or windowed retention.

groups.label: Summarizing Memories
groups.title: Conversation Summarizing Memories
groups.description: Memories that generate and maintain summaries of conversations to manage context length and provide high-level overview.

groups.label: Entity Memories
groups.title: Conversation Entity Memories
groups.description: Memories focused on extracting, summarizing, and persisting named entities from conversations using various storage backends.

groups.label: Vector Store Memories
groups.title: Vector Store Backed Memories
groups.description: Memory implementations that leverage vector stores for long-term storage and retrieval of conversation context.
